flexible_post_content.text_editor:
O3 is thrilled to announce that Christine Sheller, our Senior Vice President of Experience Research and Design, will be a keynote speaker at the BeMore Festival 2023. This 24-hour superconference, set to take place on September 20–21, brings together professionals and visionaries from over 25 countries.

This immersive event will feature live keynotes, networking opportunities, and dynamic panel discussions. With more than 100 power speakers, BeMore Festival is set to be a global gathering of minds in the fields of design, AI, product development, and career advancement.


CHECK OUT THE EVENT

Christine Sheller: A leader in design and UX

Christine Sheller is a distinguished leader with an extensive track record in building and managing design and user experience teams. At O3, Christine is responsible for overseeing all aspects of UX research and design, ensuring that our clients receive exceptional customer experiences.

Christine’s journey in design and UX has taken her through esteemed organizations such as FS Investments, SIG, Lincoln Financial Group, and Motorola, where she played pivotal roles in creating award-winning teams. Her dedication to the design community extends beyond her professional roles; she has also served on the board of AIGA Philadelphia, contributing to initiatives like the in-house design program and a design scholarship fund.

Christine holds a Master’s in User Experience Design from the Maryland Institute College of Art (MICA) and a BFA in Design from the Tyler School of Art.

Session highlight: From hurdles to high-performing teams

Christine’s session is titled “From Hurdles to High-Performing Teams: Mastering Collaboration, Career, and Beyond.” She will be joined by the following impressive UX thought leaders:

Jon Karlin: VP, Product and Strategy, Presence Product Group

David Siglin: Principal Product Designer, Merchandise at StitchFix

Stephanie Jensen Swift:  Senior Product Designer, Adobe

 

You’ll hear about their strategies for high performance, effective collaboration, career pathing strategies, and sustaining success.

O3 is thrilled to be a part of BeMore Festival 2023, underscoring our commitment to driving innovation and excellence in the fields of design and UX.
